g.title: across board g-delta-uq improves reliability confidence indicators structural distortion benchmark substantial reductions expected calibration error severe rotations keeping accuracy close vanilla model
g.desc: Across the board, G-Delta-UQ improves the reliability of confidence indicators. On the structural distortion benchmark it achieves substantial reductions in expected calibration error even at severe rotations, while keeping accuracy close to the vanilla model.
g.text: Substantial ECE reductions even at severe rotations,
while accuracy stays close to the vanilla model.

g.title: under size shift last-layer anchoring lowers calibration error maintaining improving accuracy largest gains most severe shift
g.desc: Under size shift, last-layer anchoring lowers calibration error while maintaining or improving accuracy, with the largest gains on the most severe shift.
g.text: largest gains on the most severe shift.

g.title: when confidence estimates feed downstream tasks among best single-model estimators generalization gap prediction highly competitive out-of-distribution detection pretrained variant frequently strongest covariate shift
g.desc: And when its confidence estimates feed downstream tasks, it is among the best single-model estimators for generalization gap prediction and is highly competitive for out-of-distribution detection, with the pretrained variant frequently the strongest under covariate shift.
g.text: Among the best single-model estimators for generalization-gap
prediction, and highly competitive for OOD detection.
Pretrained G-ΔUQ is frequently strongest under covariate shift.

g.title: under concept covariate shifts delivers competitive in-distribution out-of-distribution accuracy alongside better calibration other single-model methods
g.desc: Under concept and covariate shifts it delivers competitive in-distribution and out-of-distribution accuracy alongside better calibration than other single-model methods.
g.text: while improving calibration — especially versus other
